site_name: Site Of Former Northolt Grange Community Centre And Part Of St Raphael's Catholic SchoolNortholtMiddlesexUB5 6NF
description: Application for a Non-Material Amendment in (S96a) seeking to allow substitute the currently approved drawings  in relation to planning permission reference 220512FULR3 dated 23/05/2023 for: Development of 92 residential dwellings (Use Class C3) with associated vehicular and pedestrian access across three buildings ranging from two to five storeys in height, children play space, residential amenity space, public realm and landscaping works, a new public open space, vehicle and cycle parking and other associated works. (Following demolition of the existing community centre, school building, playground, MUGA and associated structures) [Regulation 3 Application by London Borough of Ealing]
